bottom of your hearts.{1a}Come, make your wish. Wish for the
coming of the 'New World'!{0c:2b5109fe}

No!

strings.tl: Don't leave me alone...

あたしは・・・淋しくなんか・・・
strings.read:
{0c:52e8f0}黙って!
あたしは淋しくなんかない!
あたしは・・・淋しくなんか・・・
strings.en: {0c:52e8f0}Be quiet! I'm not lonely! I'm... not lonely...
strings.tl: Be quiet! I'm not lonely! I'm... not lonely...
Aaaaaah!!

strings.jp:
預言者よ、目覚めよ!
『{e09f}しい世{e088}』の扉を{e0d1}け!!
strings.read:
預言者よ、目覚めよ!
『新しい世界』の扉を開け!!
strings.en:
Prophet, awaken! Open the door of the
'New World'!!
strings.tl: Prophet, awaken! Open the door of the 'New World'!!

strings.jp:
{e0d7}かった・・・
1万{e0bc}も待った・・・{0c:2b5809fe}
strings.read:
長かった・・・
1万年も待った・・・{0c:2b5809fe}
strings.en:
So long... Ten thousand years I have
waited...{0c:2b5809fe}
strings.tl: So long... Ten thousand years I have waited...

strings.en:
Now at last true eternity... true peace
shall be ours...{0c:2b5109fe}
strings.tl: Now at last true eternity... true peace shall be ours...

strings.en:
N-no... Because of me, this world will be
gone...?{0c:2b5809fe}
strings.tl: N-no... Because of me, this world will be gone...?

strings.jp:
『{e09f}しい世{e088}』の声を聞き、
『{e09f}しい世{e088}』の扉を{e0d1}く者、
それが預言者・・・{1a}汝はその預言者になったのだ。
何を悲嘆する?{0c:2b5a09fe}
strings.read:
『新しい世界』の声を聞き、
『新しい世界』の扉を開く者、
それが預言者・・・{1a}汝はその預言者になったのだ。
何を悲嘆する?{0c:2b5a09fe}
strings.en:
The one who hears the voice of the
'New World' and opens the door of the
'New World': that is the Prophet...{1a}You have become that Prophet. Why do
you grieve?{0c:2b5a09fe}
strings.tl: The one who hears the voice of the 'New World' and opens the door of the 'New World': that is the Prophet... // You have become that Prophet. Why do you grieve?
Do you not hear it? The 'New World' stirring in the womb, and the people's cries of joy!

strings.en: {10}! Kill me!
strings.tl: [HERO]! Kill me!

strings.jp:
そうじゃないの!
どうすれば悪魔になれるか
わかったの!{1a}あたしを殺せばいい!
預言者を殺せば悪魔になれるの!{0c:2b572351082b501000}{0c:2b5709fe}
strings.read:
そうじゃないの!
どうすれば悪魔になれるか
わかったの!{1a}あたしを殺せばいい!
預言者を殺せば悪魔になれるの!{0c:2b572351082b501000}{0c:2b5709fe}
strings.tl: That's not it! I know how you can become the Devil! // Just kill me! Kill the Prophet, and you can become the Devil!

strings.jp:
正解だ。
神と戦う資格を得るためには
聖{e0dd}にかかれてある{e0a4}りに
預言者を殺さなければならない。{0c:2b5109fe}
strings.read:
正解だ。
神と戦う資格を得るためには
聖書にかかれてある通りに
預言者を殺さなければならない。{0c:2b5109fe}
strings.tl: Correct. To earn the right to fight God, one must kill the Prophet, as it is written in the Scriptures.

strings.en:
If it is you, {10}, I do not mind
being killed! So please!! Quickly!!{0c:2b5a09fe}
strings.tl: If it is you, [HERO], I do not mind being killed! So please!! Quickly!!

strings.jp:
だが、こちらも
黙って見過ごすほど{e0de}かではない。
strings.read:
だが、こちらも
黙って見過ごすほど愚かではない。
strings.en:
But we are not so foolish as to stand
by in silence.
strings.tl: But we are not so foolish as to stand by in silence.

strings.en:
Die in peace. At the dawn of the 'New
World', your soul too will be saved.{0c:0280ff8001}
strings.tl: Die in peace. At the dawn of the 'New World', your soul too will be saved.

strings.en: Ngh, who is there!?
strings.tl: Ngh, who is there!?

strings.en: {0c:52b0b8}So it falls short after all...{0c:2b5a09fe}
strings.tl: So it falls short after all...
Wh-why are you here!?
Be not dismayed, Welkail. That one is a puppet with no soul... Struggle as it may, it can never become the Devil.

strings.jp:
{0c:51c0}余裕だな。
もう神になったつもりか?{0c:52c8d02b501000}{0c:2b5609fe}
strings.read:
{0c:51c0}余裕だな。
もう神になったつもりか?{0c:52c8d02b501000}{0c:2b5609fe}
strings.en:
{0c:51c0}You seem at ease. Think you are a god
already?{0c:52c8d02b501000}{0c:2b5609fe}
strings.tl: You seem at ease. Think you are a god already?

through that one's heart!{0c:2b5709fe}

{0c:51082b561000}残念だがその者には預言者を殺す

預言者を包む{e0ac}を{e086}くことも出来ねば

strings.read:
{0c:51082b561000}残念だがその者には預言者を殺す

{0c:51082b561000}Regrettably, that one has no reason to

pierce the light that surrounds the
Prophet nor become the Devil.{0c:2b5a09fe}
strings.tl: Regrettably, that one has no reason to kill the Prophet. // [1]Without a strong will, one can neither pierce the light that surrounds the Prophet nor become the Devil.

strings.tl: The s-spear!!

{10}、
あたしはあなたを信じる!!
だからっ!!!
strings.read:
{10}、
あたしはあなたを信じる!!
だからっ!!!

strings.tl: [HERO], I believe in you!! So please!!!

strings.jp:
何故立ち上がる?
汝は預言者を殺すというのか?
人{e08a}の希望を殺すというのか?{1a}『神の子殺しの悪魔』として
人{e08a}から永遠に{e0e1}み嫌われる
覚悟が出来ているのか?{1a}困難を{e0a3}に乗り越えてきた仲間を
自らの手で殺すというのか?{0c:2b5109fe}
strings.read:
何故立ち上がる?
汝は預言者を殺すというのか?
人々の希望を殺すというのか?{1a}『神の子殺しの悪魔』として
人々から永遠に忌み嫌われる
覚悟が出来ているのか?{1a}困難を共に乗り越えてきた仲間を
自らの手で殺すというのか?{0c:2b5109fe}
strings.en:
Why do you rise? Would you kill the
Prophet? Would you kill the hope of all
people?{1a}Are you prepared to be loathed forever
as the 'Devil who slew the Child of God'?{1a}Would you kill with your own hands the
comrade who has overcome hardship at
your side?{0c:2b5109fe}
strings.tl: Why do you rise? Would you kill the Prophet? Would you kill the hope of all people? // Are you prepared to be loathed forever as the 'Devil who slew the Child of God'? // Would you kill with your own hands the comrade who has overcome hardship at your side?

strings.jp:
{0c:2b512351ff592b531000}{0c:2b502351002b531000}レベッカさんには
{e0e3}死{e0e4}{e0e5}になってもらいました。{1a}{0c:5170}聖{e0dd}の文面からこうなる事を予測し、
刺さった{e0e8}間に『イス』の{e0e9}結魔{e0ea}が
{e0eb}所的に{e0ec}動する{e084}を、
ガイウスさんと{e0a3}同で造ったのです。{1a}彼らを騙せるかどうかは
賭けでしたが・・・{0c:2b5109fe}
strings.read:
{0c:2b512351ff592b531000}{0c:2b502351002b531000}レベッカさんには
仮死状態になってもらいました。{1a}{0c:5170}聖書の文面からこうなる事を予測し、
刺さった瞬間に『イス』の凍結魔法が
局所的に作動する槍を、
ガイウスさんと共同で造ったのです。{1a}彼らを騙せるかどうかは
賭けでしたが・・・{0c:2b5109fe}
strings.en:
{0c:2b512351ff592b531000}{0c:2b502351002b531000}I put Rebecca-san into a state of
suspended animation.{1a}{0c:5170}The wording of the Scriptures let me
foresee this, so together with
Gaius-san I made a spear that casts the
freezing spell 'Is' on just the spot it{1a}pierces, the instant it strikes.{1a}Whether it would deceive them was a
gamble, I admit...{0c:2b5109fe}
strings.tl: I put Rebecca-san into a state of suspended animation. // [1]The wording of the Scriptures let me foresee this, so together with Gaius-san I made a spear that casts the freezing spell 'Is' on just the spot it pierces, the instant it strikes. // Whether it would deceive them was a gamble, I admit...

strings.en: {0c:52ff61ff69}So that's how it was...{0c:2b5309fe}
strings.tl: So that's how it was...

strings.en:
{0c:527840}I am sorry, Rebecca-san, {10}-san.
There was no time to tell you...{0c:2b5109fe}
strings.tl: I am sorry, Rebecca-san, [HERO]-san. There was no time to tell you...

strings.en:
{0c:52ff71ff79}No, it's okay. I'm fine now.{1a}{0c:52ff81ff89}Oh, speaking of which, where's
Fatum-san...?{0c:2b5509fe}
strings.tl: No, it's okay. I'm fine now. // [1]Oh, speaking of which, where's Fatum-san...?

strings.en:
{0c:5130}Fatum-san {0c:2b512351ff912b551000}{0c:2b502351002b551000}has gone up to the surface
with Sadiya-san... But...{0c:5118}{0c:2b5309fe}
strings.tl: Fatum-san [1]has gone up to the surface with Sadiya-san... But...

strings.jp:
体の傷は{e0ef}っているのですが、
意識が戻らないのです。{1a}{0c:5170}{0c:51ff912b531000}{0c:2b502351002b531000}ファトゥムさんの望んでいた
永遠の眠り、
それがこのような{e083}で
訪れるなんて・・・{1a}途中からファトゥムさんを1人で
行かせてしまったことを
後悔しています。{0c:2b5109fe}
strings.read:
体の傷は治っているのですが、
意識が戻らないのです。{1a}{0c:5170}{0c:51ff912b531000}{0c:2b502351002b531000}ファトゥムさんの望んでいた
永遠の眠り、
それがこのような形で
訪れるなんて・・・{1a}途中からファトゥムさんを1人で

strings.en:
The wounds to his body have healed, but
he has not regained consciousness.{1a}{0c:5170}{0c:51ff912b531000}{0c:2b502351002b531000}The eternal sleep Fatum-san longed for,

alone partway.{0c:2b5109fe}
strings.tl: The wounds to his body have healed, but he has not regained consciousness. // [1]The eternal sleep Fatum-san longed for, and it should come in such a form... // I regret having let Fatum-san go on alone partway.

strings.en: {0c:52ff99ffa1}I see...{0c:fe}
strings.tl: I see...

扉が閉じてしまいます!!{0c:fe}
strings.read:
急ぎましょう!
扉が閉じてしまいます!!{0c:fe}
